stock: PowerShell edition: unknown — assume Windows PowerShell 5.1 for compatibility
- Do NOT use `&&`, `||`, ternary `?:`, null-coalescing `??`, or null-conditional `?.`. These are PowerShell 7+ only and parser-error on 5.1.
- To chain commands conditionally: `A; if ($?) { B }`. Unconditionally: `A; B`.
unnerf: PowerShell edition: unknown. Assume Windows PowerShell 5.1 for compatibility.
- Do NOT use `&&`, `||`, ternary `?:`, null-coalescing `??`, or null-conditional `?.`. These work in PowerShell 7+ only. They cause a parser error on 5.1.
- To chain commands with a condition: `A; if ($?) { B }`. To chain without a condition: `A; B`.
